join.title: Sing with us
join.intro: Do you love to sing and to serve God through music? Chorale Christus Regnat welcomes new members who want to praise God through liturgical and gospel music.

steps.title: Come to a rehearsal
steps.text: Visit us on a Tuesday or Friday evening at Ste Famille (JOC) and tell us you would like to join the choir.

steps.title: Choose your section
steps.text: Most people who join already sing, so you start in the section you know: soprano, alto, tenor or bass. You rehearse as a new member while the choir follows your attendance.

steps.title: Evaluation
steps.text: The technical team evaluates you and may move you to a section that suits you better. If you are not ready yet, you keep rehearsing and are evaluated again later.

steps.title: Become a full member
steps.text: After a successful evaluation, you are a full member: you take part in the General Assembly and pay the monthly contribution.
